description: Check the sitemap (cvrt-seo-manager 1.15.0+, feature sitemap_health; refused with a clear message on an older plugin): the site fetches every sitemap file and every listed URL on its own host (redirects not followed) and returns { total, offset, checked, truncated, next_offset, sitemaps_checked, sitemaps_pending, findings: [{ url, type, detail }], limits, duration_ms, build_ms }. Finding types: status (not 200), redirect, noindex (robots meta or X-Robots-Tag), canonical (another URL), sitemap (a sitemap file not 200), sitemap_timeout (a sitemap file that does not fit the budget even on a call that only checks the files), offsite (not on the site's host, never fetched). One request at a time, 8 s timeout each, a request starts only when it can end within 25 s (the sitemap build, reported as build_ms, counts against it), and every call checks at least one URL, so a call lasts about max(build + 8 s, 25 s); page with offset = next_offset while truncated. Sitemap files are checked at offset 0 or when sitemaps=true; if a call answers sitemaps_pending: true (a slow cold build left no budget for them), pass sitemaps=true with the next offset; on the last page next_offset = total (that call only checks the files).

limit.description: URLs to check in this call (1-500, default 100)

offset.description: Index of the first URL to check (default 0; use next_offset to continue)

sitemaps.description: Check the sitemap files on this call (default: only at offset 0); send true after a response with sitemaps_pending

name: seo_sitemap_health
